guitar.modelsText: G&L Rampage (early) / Gibson Les Paul (signature model)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cantrell is well documented playing a G&L Rampage in early Alice in Chains years, later closely associated with Gibson Les Paul (his own signature model).
guitar.notes: Original entry correct and well documented.

tone.target: dark grunge crunch with thick fuzz edge
tone.profile: dark grunge crunch with thick fuzz edge
tone.summary: A heavy, sludgy grunge tone achieved with a fuzz/distortion pre, followed by a UK 50 amp model, paired with a UK Vintage 4x12 cab for massive, dry punch.
corrections: favor gritty crunch over full fuzz

rig.name: Alice in Chains - Rain When I Die - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and excessive noise inherent in heavy grunge tones.
Provide the initial thick fuzz edge and gritty crunch required for grunge.

alternatives.reason: Could provide a more psychedelic/vintage grit, but Distortion is better for modern sludge.

blocks.purpose: Add mid-range punch and tighten the riff structure without losing fuzz thickness.
Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi style amp for massive, aggressive British crunch.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more focused on rhythm than the UK 50's overall punch.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required massive 4x12 cabinet sound for punchy grunge.
Sculpt the low mids and tighten the overall frequency response for a sludgy feel.
Add a subtle sense of space and dimension without sounding like deep reverb.

alternatives.reason: Too bright/polished for the dark grunge tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the massive, dry punch required for grunge.

proposals.reason: The current IR is generic; a specific high-gain model will enhance the sludge and punch.
